items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: we got the bass from our bass player which was sick Pete Blanchett

ctx.x: You heard of him though, yeah? Well we hired him to play bass. But he didn't have a bass so we got the bass from our bass player which was sick Pete Blanchett. So we brought the bass over to the hall and we waited for him and he didn't come. And it was time to leave. So T-Boy said to me, he says, go in the hall and get that bass. I says, I can't play no bass man. Go get the bass like I'm telling you. Well I went and got the bass but I had never played bass before. I've had them in my hands but I never even tried…
